correctness.rationale: For n product of prime powers the bi-unitary condition removes only the middle divisor p^{a/2} for even exponent a, so F(p^a)=Σ_{j=0}^a p^{-2j}-1_{2|a}p^{-a}. Its local closure contains 1 and C_p=(1-p^-2)^-1. For primes p>=5, independently verified 10 finite rational witness products; for p>=41, fifth Ramanujan prime R5=41 gives five primes p<q<2p, forcing ∏_{q>p}C_q>C_p. Thus the binary-series interval lemma applied to log C_p fills [1,T=π²/9] by finite-support approximations. The eight independent scale factors from p=2 and3 are {1,17/16,9/8,153/128,5/4,4/3,45/32,3/2}; their maximum adjacent ratio is 16/15<T, so scaled intervals overlap and fill [1,(3/2)T]=[1,π²/6]. The universal divisor bound gives the other inclusion. Independent direct bi-unitary divisor enumeration for n<=256 and exact rational witness checks corroborated steps, but cannot replace Ramanujan or the series lemma.
